messages.text: BL-1726 🎵 in progress — BL-1705's landed ghost reaper (ca2a683e48) reaps ANY llama-server whose parent is not a live ollama serve, at any age - so a llama.cpp server the human starts by hand outside the swarm (parent: a shell) is killed at the next janitor sweep; a runner counts as ollama's own only when its executable is inside an ollama installation's lib directory AND its --model is an ollama model blob, and every other llama-server is never signalled
